opening.argument: The presentation ties paid OneAcademy packages to tokens used in a mining process, while displaying package prices from EUR 100 to EUR 5000 and an additional 30 EUR registration fee. It also presents a OneCard as a way to transfer claimed earnings onto a debit card for immediate use. Alongside those paid offerings, the speaker reports that OneCoin created 285 new millionaires and urges viewers to set up a membership, describing the opportunity as already changing lives. That goes beyond neutral discussion by linking payment, mining-related tokens, earnings access, wealth claims, and an explicit membership appeal. Forbes-related material is shown, but the disclosure identifies it as paid advertising and says Forbes Bulgaria does not represent the product; the wealth, token, earnings, and gold-related claims remain unverified.
